verdict.rationale: Circle publishes an llms.txt that a probe confirmed returns HTTP 200, with a dedicated "Agent Instructions" section. The docs site tells agents to "Fetch the complete documentation index at /llms.txt", and pages are served as .md files. The llms.txt also points agents to installable Circle skills for Claude Code and the Vercel Skills CLI. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually consuming these docs well, and evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developers.circle.com/llms.txt # Circle Docs
Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](/llms.txt)
In Claude Code: run /plugin marketplace add circlefin/skills then /plugin install circle-skills@circle.
